content: The laboratory evaluation should be conducted in accordance with the guidelines provided by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). Additional screenings should include the administration of COVID-19 vaccinations to protect against SARS-CoV-2 infection. Adults under the age of 60 should receive the hepatitis B vaccine to prevent hepatitis B virus infection. Furthermore, individuals who are considered high-risk should be given the influenza vaccine to reduce the risk of complications associated with influenza.
